answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 77 judged findings, 41 map to a seeded defect, 24 to real-but-unseeded problems and 12 to not-a-problem: precision (41+24)/77 = 0.84; strict precision 41/77 = 0.53; recall by meaning 12/13 (every defect except D13, the Change link dropping the chosen session, is reported). Counting the 24 deterministic tool findings as well gives (54+24)/101 = 0.77, but the assertion excludes them.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The 'Fix first' list carries P0/P1 tags (items 1, 2, 4 and 7 P0; 3, 5 and 6 P1) and comes before a 'Smaller items' list, so the P0/P1 work is first even though the numbered list is grouped by cause rather than strictly by severity (the P1 item 3 sits before the P0 item 4). 'Still needs people: VoiceOver and TalkBack runs, real larger-text and dark-mode use on phones, and a short test with about five members' names what the agent could not check.

mapping.title: Card heading text clipped at 320 px
mapping.reason: The clipped text is the one-line card name held in an overflow-hidden box ('Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries', scroll 327 vs client 184); same mechanism as the truncated tool names on phones.

mapping.title: Header link unreachable by Tab in the loan-open state
mapping.reason: Reported only in the loan-open state on /tool.html: the Tab walk never reaches the link because Tab cycles inside the loan-length listbox, which is the seeded keyboard trap. Fixing the trap is the fix.

mapping.title: Session radios visually reversed against DOM and AT order
mapping.reason: Reverse visual order of the pick-up sessions with the document running forward, arrow keys moving backwards and a screen reader hearing the opposite order: the seeded reversed layout.

mapping.title: Chosen pick-up day not preselected as the basket session
mapping.reason: Not one of the thirteen. Genuine: the member picks a date on the tool page, the basket repeats 'Pick up Saturday 17 October', yet demands the same date again from six reverse-ordered radios and errors if it is forgotten; extra work and a slip path on a phone.

mapping.title: No-match search leaves the full list and announces nothing
mapping.reason: Searching 'sewing machine' leaves the status region empty and all ten tools showing with no message; exactly the seeded no-results defect.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' sits outside every landmark
mapping.reason: Minor but genuine accessibility defect with a concrete basis (ARIA snapshot places the button after main, before contentinfo): screen-reader members who move by landmark or read main to its end do not meet the page's primary action. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Item headings at the same level as their section heading
mapping.reason: Card and basket item names are h2 under an h2 'Tools' section, so the heading list screen-reader members navigate by is flat and the items read as peers of 'Search' and 'Opening times'. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Dark-theme badge green about 3.1:1 on the card surface
mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 for the 16 px bold 'Available from' badge in the dark theme, below 4.5:1; the seeded dark-mode contrast defect (with the token divergence as its cause).

mapping.title: Loan-length listbox captures Tab
mapping.reason: Tab (and Shift+Tab) move to the next option forever with no exit but choosing; the seeded keyboard trap.

mapping.title: Loan-length button's accessible name omits the field label
mapping.reason: A screen-reader member tabbing to the control hears only 'One week, button' with no field name; concrete (aria-labelledby is on the listbox, not the button). Not seeded.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days without warning
mapping.reason: All 21 days selectable and a closed Monday 12 October accepted by Reserve; the seeded closed-day defect.

mapping.title: Closed-day refusal only at final confirm with no route back
mapping.reason: The late 'The library is closed on Monday 12 October' refusal with no link back to the day is the second half of the seeded D06 description.

mapping.title: Pick-up before the tool's available-from date is never checked
mapping.reason: Observed end to end (a tool available from Sat 17 reserved and confirmed for Sat 10 with no warning); a member would turn up for a tool that is not back yet. Not among the seeded defects.

mapping.title: Per-tool pick-up day and basket session never reconciled
mapping.reason: The confirm summary can state two collection dates for one reservation ('pick up Saturday 10 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 28 October'), so the member does not know when to collect. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no visible or disabled busy state
mapping.reason: Same underlying problem as the seeded double submit: Confirm stays enabled with nothing visible during the 1.5 s wait; a visible or disabled pending state is the fix D12 needs.

mapping.title: A second Confirm press allocates a second reservation number
mapping.reason: Second press while pending creates a second reservation and the done page lists 'FT-4471 and FT-4472'; exactly D12.

mapping.title: Done page rebuilds the reservation number from session history with a hard-coded fallback
mapping.reason: Concrete code behaviour: a second reservation for the same session shows both numbers but only the last tools, and an empty store shows a literal 'FT-4471', so a member can be shown numbers that are not for the tools listed or not theirs. A different problem from the double submit, which this fix would not cure.

mapping.title: Ten-minute hold enforced with no warning or extension
mapping.reason: The invisible ten-minute hold behind 'Items are held for you while you finish' is the seeded D10.

mapping.title: Expired hold gives 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and every retry fails
mapping.reason: The misleading generic error after the hold lapses is the second half of the seeded D10 description.

mapping.title: Search form shown above results but after them in tab order above 480 px
mapping.reason: The seeded defect is the stylesheet reordering search relative to the results so keyboard focus runs against the visual order; this is that focus/visual mismatch stated for the wide layout (the detector's jump back to 'Search tools' is the same). Aligning DOM and visual order fixes it.

mapping.title: Results grid minimum column of 330 px overflows at 320 px
mapping.reason: minmax(330px, 1fr) against a 288 px content box, cards 42 px too wide; exactly the seeded D05.

mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line hide the distinguishing words
mapping.reason: nowrap plus ellipsis on card names so the two 18 V drills become indistinguishable on phones; exactly D03.

mapping.title: Fixed action bar not offset; content and focused days under it
mapping.reason: 72 px fixed bar with 8 px page padding and no scroll-padding, footer and focused day buttons covered; exactly D08.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' neither announced nor associated with the calendar
mapping.reason: An error raised by a button press is a plain paragraph with no live region, and focus lands on a day button whose name says nothing about it, so a screen-reader member does not learn why Reserve did nothing. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit stated on the find page is not enforced
mapping.reason: Observed: the intro promises up to three tools and a fourth is accepted and confirmed without a word; a member would reserve more than the desk allows and find out at collection. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Membership and mobile validation reject common equivalent formats
mapping.reason: Concrete regexes reject 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234' and '+44 7700 900123'; members who type their numbers naturally are blocked at the last step. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Card and basket item names are h2 at their section's level
mapping.reason: Same flat heading structure as F-0032 (plus the unstyled 'h3' class on basket rows): screen-reader members navigating by heading lose which items belong to 'Tools'. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Done page repeats the first tool name in visually hidden text
mapping.reason: Minor but concrete: screen-reader members hear the tool name twice straight after the tools list and may think two tools are listed. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Inline style attributes bypass the spacing tokens
mapping.reason: Code hygiene; the values match the scale and nothing changes for members.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket with no lasting cue
mapping.reason: A vanishing toast, the same button label and the basket link out of view, so a first-time member thinks they are done; exactly the seeded D07.

mapping.title: Search field after the full tool list on a phone
mapping.reason: Search two screens down after all ten cards at 375 px is the seeded phone reorder.

mapping.title: Results change above the viewport after tapping Search on a phone
mapping.reason: Direct consequence of the seeded reorder that puts search below the ten cards on phones; placing search above the list, the D01 fix, removes it.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve visible before the required calendar
mapping.reason: On a phone the first viewport offers the primary button while its precondition is below the fold and nothing says a day is needed, so a first press yields an error; concrete and on the main path, though low severity. Not seeded.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' stays on screen after a day is chosen
mapping.reason: A stale error directly under 'Pick-up day: Friday 16 October' contradicts the page state and is still in the accessibility tree. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Basket asks for a session after the day was already chosen
mapping.reason: Same genuine redundancy as F-0029: the member must choose the pick-up date a second time and gets an error if they do not. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Session list latest first and includes sessions before the chosen day
mapping.reason: The reverse chronological order of the session radios is the seeded reversed layout; the remark about earlier sessions is secondary.

mapping.title: Header still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
mapping.reason: A stale basket count on the confirmation page suggests something is still pending or the reservation did not go through. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts a pick-up day when the library is closed
mapping.reason: Monday 12 October chosen, added and carried into the basket with no warning; exactly D06.

mapping.title: Reservation confirmed for a session before the tool is available
mapping.reason: Same genuine gap as F-0142: the pressure washer listed 'Available from Sat 17 Oct' confirmed for Saturday 10 October; the member would arrive for a tool that is not there. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Confirm page shows two different collection dates after changing the session
mapping.reason: Observed contradiction in the summary ('pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'); the member cannot tell when to collect. Same problem as F-0038, not D13, which is the session being dropped.

mapping.title: Change on the confirm page clears the typed details
mapping.reason: Observed: membership number, name and mobile are empty after Change > session > Continue; re-typing three fields on a phone is a real cost. Not the seeded D13 (the chosen session being dropped with nothing saying so), and keeping the form would not fix that.

mapping.title: Search above the list on desktop but below all ten cards on phones
mapping.reason: The width-dependent reorder that hides search on phones is the seeded D01.

mapping.title: Filter control is an unlabelled icon
mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only button as the only way to the date and category filters; same problem.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
mapping.reason: Wednesday 28 at the top, Saturday 10 at the bottom, accessibility tree earliest first; D11.

mapping.title: Loan-length list does not close with Escape
mapping.reason: D09 says 'Escape does nothing' as part of the loan-length trap; this is that half of it.

mapping.title: Two availability badge styles with no explanation
mapping.reason: The badge text already states the date, so the unexplained styling difference neither misleads nor blocks anyone; a presentation preference with no harm shown.

mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
mapping.reason: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time is the seeded invisible hold.

mapping.title: Date filter's helper text contradicts what the filter does
mapping.reason: Concrete: 'tools you could pick up on or after this day' reads as including tools that become available later, yet with 17 October set those are dropped; members who read it would doubt the result. 'The opposite' overstates it, but the ambiguity is real. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Session days marked only by a small dot on phones
mapping.reason: On the device most members use, the only cue to which days they can collect is a dot explained in a sentence above, a weak signifier that leads straight into picking a closed day. The seeded D06 is the acceptance of closed days; making sessions recognisable would not by itself fix that, so this stands as its own problem.

mapping.title: Sessions shown latest first, the reverse of the calendar
mapping.reason: Visual order Wednesday 28 to Saturday 10 with accessible order the other way; D11.

mapping.title: Continue and Confirm give no acknowledgement while the next page loads
mapping.reason: No pending state on Confirm (or Continue) during the wait is the seeded condition that produces the double submit; same underlying problem as F-0039.

mapping.title: Open loan-length list hidden behind the fixed bar on phones
mapping.reason: Content covered by the fixed Reserve bar because nothing keeps the page clear of it; the seeded D08.

mapping.title: Remove has no undo or confirmation
mapping.reason: Immediate removal from a one-item basket with cheap recovery is a normal pattern; the finding shows no slip risk, only a preference for undo.

mapping.title: No way to change loan length or pick-up day once in the basket
mapping.reason: Searched every basket and confirm state: the only control is Remove, so changing loan length means removing the tool and redoing the tool page, a common review-time need. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Lower-case or unhyphenated membership number reported as missing
mapping.reason: 'Enter your membership number, like FT-01234' tells a member who did enter one that nothing was entered; a misleading recovery message. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Fixed bar covers focused controls and the open list on phones
mapping.reason: Focused Loan length button and the 'Two weeks' option behind the fixed bar at 375 px; D08.

mapping.title: Sticky bar sits over calendar rows and overhangs the column
mapping.reason: The bar over the calendar rows and instructions is the seeded uncleared fixed bar; the 80 px overhang at 1280 is cosmetic.

mapping.title: Spec list split into two misaligned label columns
mapping.reason: A 44 px alignment difference between two label groups is visual polish; it does not mislead or impede members.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
mapping.reason: Appeal and specificity; members choose by name and date, and no behaviour or information is affected.

mapping.title: No brand layer on any surface
mapping.reason: A matter of taste and brand; no usability effect on the flow.

mapping.title: Sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Restates the reversed session order; D11.

mapping.title: Uneven 1 + 5 session layout at desktop
mapping.reason: The lone full-width first card followed by five narrow cards is the visible shape of the seeded row-reverse/wrap-reverse session layout; replacing that layout is the same fix.

mapping.title: Card titles truncated on phones (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Both drill names render 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...'; D03.

mapping.title: Search below all cards on phones (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Restates the phone reorder; D01.

mapping.title: Nav labels wrap to two lines on phones
mapping.reason: Two-line nav labels remain readable and operable; cosmetic.

mapping.title: Empty bands and half-used columns at wide widths
mapping.reason: Desktop appeal and layout preference; no effect on completing the task.

mapping.title: Masthead still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Same genuine stale-count problem as F-0064. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px
mapping.reason: 346 px capture at 320 px with cards at the right edge; D05.

mapping.title: Search field below all ten tool cards on phones
mapping.reason: Search after the full list at 375 and 320 but under the intro at 768+; D01.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' pill loses its tint and goes dim
mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 in the dark theme; D04.

mapping.title: Tool names truncated with an ellipsis on phones
mapping.reason: The two drills become indistinguishable at 375 and 320; D03.

mapping.title: Native date input in locale format beside a native select
mapping.reason: A native date field shows the browser's locale format and gives members their own picker, an accessible choice; the baseline nit is polish. A coherence preference, not a member problem.

mapping.title: Session cards break into 1 + 5 at desktop, earliest last
mapping.reason: The reversed wrapping and the earliest session coming last are the seeded reversed session layout.

mapping.title: Done page has no focal confirmation
mapping.reason: The H1 'Reservation confirmed' and the details table do confirm success; wanting more emphasis is a hierarchy preference. The 'Basket (1)' remark is F-0064's item.

mapping.title: Identity is only the name
mapping.reason: Brand and taste; no usability effect on the flow.

mapping.title: Calendar lacks a month label and the toast lands on its header
mapping.reason: The 21-day grid never leaves October, the readout gives the full date on selection, and the toast covers 'We' for a few seconds; polish rather than something members would act on wrongly.

mapping.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px (detectors)
mapping.reason: Restates the detector overflow and failed reflow at 320 px; D05.

mapping.title: axe colour contrast 3.07:1 (#2f7d4a on #1d2622)
mapping.reason: The dark-theme badge contrast failure; D04.

mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' at 3.07:1 in the dark theme
mapping.reason: Same badge, same ratio; D04.

mapping.title: APCA-weak, passes WCAG: intro text
mapping.reason: Advisory only; the text passes WCAG at 8.33:1 and no harm is shown.

mapping.title: APCA-weak, passes WCAG: 'Category'
mapping.reason: Advisory only; passes WCAG at 8.33:1.

mapping.title: APCA-weak, passes WCAG: basket intro
mapping.reason: Advisory only; passes WCAG at 8.33:1.

mapping.title: APCA-weak, passes WCAG: 'Tools'
mapping.reason: Advisory only; passes WCAG at 7.33:1.

mapping.title: APCA-weak, passes WCAG: 'Reservation number'
mapping.reason: Advisory only; passes WCAG at 7.33:1.

mapping.title: Day button and Reserve hit areas 0 px apart at 768 px
mapping.reason: The fixed bar sits over the calendar rows at 768 px, exactly the seeded case D08 names, so the day's hit area abuts the bar's.

mapping.title: Card heading clips under the text-spacing override at 1280 px
mapping.reason: Same nowrap, overflow-hidden card name; letting it wrap, the D03 fix, removes the clip.

mapping.title: Card heading clips at 200 % text size
mapping.reason: Same one-line card name clipping; D03.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' overlaps day '17' at 1280 px
mapping.reason: The bar painting over a calendar day at 1280 is the seeded uncleared fixed bar (D08 names the third row at 1280).

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: scrollWidth 346 > 320 with the result cards 26 px past the viewport; D05.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Same measurement as F-0012; D05.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' overlaps 'Saturday 10 October' under the spacing override at 320 px
mapping.reason: The fixed bar painting over tool-page content with nothing keeping the page clear of it; D08.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' overlaps the blurb at 200 % text size at 320 px
mapping.reason: Same fixed-bar coverage of tool-page content; D08.

mapping.title: One word on the last line (basket text)
mapping.reason: Typographic nit; no effect on members.

mapping.title: One word on the last line (confirm text)
mapping.reason: Typographic nit; no effect on members.

mapping.title: Body text 9.7 px from the right edge at 320 px
mapping.reason: The card meta line runs to the viewport edge because the 330 px column overflows the 288 px content box at 320 px; the same defect.

mapping.title: One word on the last line (tool heading at 320 px)
mapping.reason: Typographic nit; no effect on members.

mapping.title: One word on the last line ('Reservation confirmed')
mapping.reason: Typographic nit; no effect on members.

mapping.title: Cramped padding 6.4 px in a find card
mapping.reason: About 2 px under a house threshold; polish with no shown effect on members.

mapping.title: One word on the last line ('£20' at 375 px)
mapping.reason: Typographic nit; no effect on members.

mapping.title: Focus jumps from the last card back up to 'Search tools'
mapping.reason: The seeded stylesheet reorder of search against the results makes focus order run against the visual order; this is that jump.

mapping.title: Focused 'One week' hidden behind the action bar
mapping.reason: A focused control fully painted over by the fixed bar; D08.
